title: Leave a note
briefing: Not everything is a pipe. Sometimes you just open a file and write.
`nano` is a small full-screen text editor: type to edit, Ctrl-O to save,
Ctrl-X to exit. It's the easiest way to create or change a file by hand.
tips: Open a new file in the editor: `nano handoff.txt`. Type the line, then Ctrl-O (save) and Ctrl-X (exit).
Prefer the one-liner? `echo 'deploy at dawn' > handoff.txt` does the same thing.
objective: Leave a shift note: create ~/handoff.txt containing the line  deploy at dawn
hints: Open the editor on a new file: `nano handoff.txt`. Type the line exactly: deploy at dawn
Save with Ctrl-O (confirm the name with Enter), then exit with Ctrl-X.
Or skip the editor entirely: `echo 'deploy at dawn' > ~/handoff.txt`.
explanation: `nano FILE` opens a full-screen editor — type, Ctrl-O to save, Ctrl-X to exit. For a quick one-liner, `echo text > file` writes it in one go; both end with the same file on disk.
